page.overview:
Who is Guardian of Kublai Khan?

The Guardian of Kublai Khan, also known as the Dragon Fortress Statue or Dragon Fortress Guardian, is an Orient Expedition minifigure exclusive to the 7419 Dragon Fortress set in 2003.

The Guardian of Kublai Khan is almost entirely dark grey, with the only exception being the glowing red/orange eyes and black facial features printed on its head. It wears dark grey Samurai Armour and a dark grey Bat Helmet, and it carries a Scimitar and Battle Shield.

According to the official building instructions for 7419 Dragon Fortress, the Guardian's armor is reversed from how it is portrayed in the comics and The Quest For The Golden Dragon: the indent in its Samurai Armour is backward in the instructions, while it faces forward (consistent with the piece's use in most samurai minifigures) in all other media.

The Guardian of Kublai Khan is a statue of an armored Chinese warrior found in the Guardian's Chamber, located a secret passage deep within the Dragon Fortress. When Lord Sam Sinister "awakens" the Guardian, it scares him away and then goes back to "sleep". When the Adventurers give the statue the Golden Shield, Golden Sword, and Golden Helmet, the statue gives them two Golden Keys in exchange, which open up two doors. Turning the wheels behind these doors removes the Guardian's Chamber and reveals the hidden room containing the Golden Dragon.
